title: Instruction-Tuning Open-Weight Language Models for BPMN Model Generation
abstract: arXiv:2512.12063v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Domain models are central to software engineering, as they enable a shared understanding, guide implementation, and support automated analyses and model-driven development. Yet, despite these benefits, practitioners often skip modeling because it is time-consuming and demands scarce expertise. We address this barrier by investigating whether open-weight large language models, adapted via instruction tuning, can generate high-quality BPMN process models directly from natural language descriptions in a cost-effective and privacy-preserving way. We introduce InstruBPM, a reproducible approach that prepares paired text-diagram data and instruction tunes an open source large language model with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and quantization for on-prem deployment. We evaluate the tuned model through complementary perspectives: (i) text/code similarity using BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR, (ii) structural fidelity using Relative Graph Edit Di

translated_title: 面向BPMN模型生成的开源权重语言模型指令微调
translated_abstract: 领域模型是软件工程的核心，它们能够促进共享理解、指导实现，并支持自动化分析和模型驱动开发。然而，尽管有这些好处，从业者往往因为建模耗时且需要稀缺的专业知识而跳过建模。为解决这一障碍，我们研究了经过指令微调适配的开源权重大语言模型，能否以经济高效且保护隐私的方式直接从自然语言描述生成高质量的BPMN流程模型。我们提出了InstruBPM，这是一种可复现的方法，它准备成对的文本-图表数据，并通过参数高效微调和量化技术对开源大语言模型进行指令微调，以实现本地化部署。我们从互补的角度评估微调后的模型：（i）使用BLEU、ROUGE-L和METEOR衡量文本/代码相似度，（ii）使用相对图编辑距离衡量结构保真度。
tldr: 该论文提出InstruBPM方法，通过成对的文本-图表数据对开源大语言模型进行指令微调，并结合参数高效微调与量化技术，使其能够以低成本、保护隐私的本地化部署方式从自然语言描述直接生成高质量的BPMN流程模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces InstruBPM, a reproducible approach that instruction-tunes open-weight LLMs using paired text-diagram data with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and quantization, enabling cost-effective, privacy-preserving on-prem generation of high-quality BPMN process models from natural language descriptions.
